title_en: The Mahdi (peace be upon him) in the Sahih Works of the School of the Companions (Part 2)
description_en: The Mahdi (peace be upon him) in the Sahih works of the School of the Companions (Part 2), an episode of the Mahdist Thesis program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses references to the Mahdi in the authentic hadith collections of the school of the Companions, as part of the Mahdist Thesis program on Al-Kawthar TV.
